mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_histories ( customer_id, business_id, reservation_id, staff_id, visit_date, services, total_price, details, before_image_url, after_image_url, admin_memo ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{businessId}, #{reservationId}, #{staffId}, #{visitDate}, #{services, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{totalPrice}, #{details, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{beforeImageUrl}, #{afterImageUrl}, #{adminMemo} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM customer_histories WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY visit_date DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update:
UPDATE customer_histories
staff_id = #{staffId}, visit_date = #{visitDate},
services = #{services, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb,
total_price = #{totalPrice},
details = #{details, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb,
before_image_url = #{beforeImageUrl}, after_image_url = #{afterImageUrl}, admin_memo = #{adminMemo},
WHERE id = #{id}
